name: IFR/Aeroflex/Marconi 2947A Communications Analyzer restoration and firmware reverse engineering

mentions.name: IFR/Aeroflex/Marconi 2947A Communications Analyzer restoration and firmware reverse engineering
mentions.description: This project restores an IFR/Aeroflex/Marconi 2947A Communications Analyzer to working condition and uses Ghidra to disassemble the firmware running on its main CPUs, including a 68000-based cellular option, treating it like a million-piece jigsaw puzzle.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've helped a friend get an IFR/Aeroflex/Marconi 2947A Communications Analyzer working, and am now in the process of using Ghidra to disassemble the firmware that runs on the main CPU. (There are several, including a 68000 based cellular option). I think of it as a million piece jigsaw puzzle.
